We keep correcting work that already holds because completion leaves no standard left to chase. The structure may be sound, yet our lives narrow around maintaining it. try_this: We can finish one task at the standard it actually requires, without adding another round to prove commitment.
We can eat one full meal away from work and leave the phone in another room.
